text:
Emma: Quick Q — for the automatic switchover feature, do we surface any user-facing "degraded" state? Also how do we capture the rationale so SRE/compliance can audit why a switch happened?

Sanjay: We currently emit a decision_trace span in telemetry for each automated action, but Console doesn’t surface it today.

Rachel: Design instinct: subtle, non-alarming indicator. e.g. a faint banner: "Serving via fallback model (tap for details)". Drilldown should show reasons + last N traces.

Mike: From oncall POV we need stable trace IDs + a sample of input/output to reproduce. Also need clarity on triggers: is it only 429/5xx or quality regressions too? :thinking_face:

Emma: Proposed trigger list to discuss: 429 (rate limit), quota_exhaustion, GPU_OOM, runtime_exception, latency_p95 breach, and quality regression flagged by evals. Also want a sampling TTL so once a request is sampled we keep collecting traces for X mins.

Sanjay: Draft policy YAML for discussion:
```yaml
policy:
  name: auto-switchover
  scope: route|customer
  triggers:
    - type: http_status
      code: 429
    - type: runtime_error
      subclass: OOM
    - type: latency_p95
      threshold_ms: 2000
    - type: quality_regression
      eval_set: critical_prompts
  actions:
    - switch_to: model-small-v2
    - emit_audit: switch_event
    - sample_rate: 0.05
```

Rachel: UI notes: show a compact toast + a "Decision details" flyout. Flyout should include a) trigger type, b) samples (if available), c) link to trace in observability, d) timestamp and who/what triggered it. Keep copy calm: "Serving a compatible model to preserve availability."

Sanjay: Ops note: sample_rate=0.05 might be fine for normal ops but we need a quick way to bump to e.g. 100% for an incident window or set an ad-hoc snapshot. Also consider a cool-down so we don’t oscillate.

Emma: Compliance: audit events must be stored 90d and exportable to SIEM (syslog/S3). Enterprise customers may require full payload retention opt-in. We should add a consent/opt-in flag per-customer.

ops-bot: Incident created: #1234 — auto-switchover spike detected for route `/v1/generate` in region us-west2.

Mike: Agreed on retention + opt-in. Also want per-customer toggles: allow enterprises to disable automatic switchover and opt for manual failover.

Sanjay: API question: should policy be evaled per-request (real-time) or batched? Real-time gives fastest response but more CPU; batching yields stability. Maybe hybrid: real-time for hard errors (OOM/5xx/429), rolling-window for latency/quality signals.

Rachel: Action items: 1) I’ll mock the Decision panel + toast (wireframes + microcopy) by Fri. 2) Product/Legal confirm retention/export requirements. 3) Infra to add stable decision_trace id in logs and an endpoint to fetch sampled I/O.

Emma: I’ll create a follow-up doc with scope + acceptance criteria and schedule a 30m sync. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
